einzeiler: Season 2 finale featuring an all-play trivia game all about Titans.
kurzfassung: The trivia crew closes out their second season with a special all-play trivia game centered entirely around the theme of Titans. They test each other's knowledge on mythology, sports, movies, and historical rebrandings while celebrating the show's milestones. Along the way, they reflect on season stats, share behind-the-scenes insights, and announce a transition to video for season three.
stichpunkte: The hosts discuss their childhood collecting habits, ranging from baseball cards to coins and arrowheads.
Season two comes to a close with 105 official episodes in the books and video episodes launching on YouTube next week.
The team shares a celebratory toast with Wisconsin beers provided by a listener's family member.
Superfan Joshua Wilson submits the all-play trivia round themed entirely around Titans.
Trivia questions cover topics including quarterback Steve McNair, the Nissan Titan, Cal State Fullerton, Greek mythology, and the New York Jets.
Season statistics are revealed, showing Scotty leading in victories with 23.
The hosts reflect on their favorite episodes from the season, highlighting topics like shopping malls and historical origins.

The Season 2 finale is here, and it's only fitting that a listener submission comes with a little friendly revenge. 😏 This All Play is titled Remember the Titans—a not-so-subtle nod to the movie question Nick famously missed long ago... and one the guys have refused to let him forget.
Before the trivia, Andy gets to know the Crew with questions about collectibles, favorite meals of the day, and other random quirks. Then the Question of the Week asks: If you had the strength of a Titan, what would you do with it? 💪 One answer somehow leads to the dream of finally mastering the perfect cartwheel.
The trivia itself is every bit as epic as the title, covering Titans of every variety—from mythology and movies to vehicles, mascots, and beyond. It's another listener-created gauntlet that keeps everyone guessing.
Can you finish Season 2 stronger than The Crew? Let us know how many you got right! 🏆
